# Minecraft Launcher UI/UX Audit (07-main-advanced.png) ## VISUAL HIERARCHY & LAYOUT ISSUE #1 [SEVERITY: Medium] [FRAMEWORK: Nielsen] [CRITERION: Consistency and Standards] Description: Inconsistent spacing between the "PLAY" button and the LunaSMP advertisement card. The vertical gap appears larger than standard spacing patterns. Impact: Disrupts visual flow and makes the interface feel unpolished. Fix: Standardize vertical spacing to 24px using `margin-bottom: 24px;` on the PLAY button container. ISSUE #2 [SEVERITY: Low] [FRAMEWORK: LawOfUX] [CRITERION: Law of Proximity] Description: The "Loading skin..." text is positioned centrally but lacks clear visual grouping with the PLAY button below it. Impact: Users may perceive these elements as unrelated, reducing task flow clarity. Fix: Add a 16px margin between the loading text and PLAY button: `margin-top: 16px;` on the PLAY button container. ## COLOR & CONTRAST ISSUE #3 [SEVERITY: Critical] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)] Description: The "Loading content..." text in the WHAT'S NEW section has insufficient contrast against the dark background. Measured ratio: 3.8:1 (requires 4.5:1). Impact: Low-vision users cannot read this text. Fix: Increase text brightness or background lightness. Target: `#CCCCCC` text on `#121212` background (4.6:1 ratio). ISSUE #4 [SEVERITY: Critical] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)] Description: The "Loading skin..." text has contrast ratio of 4.2:1 (requires 4.5:1). Impact: Fails WCAG AA compliance for normal text. Fix: Change to `#EEEEEE` text (4.9:1 ratio) or increase background lightness. ISSUE #5 [SEVERITY: Medium] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast] Description: The green "Join" button has border contrast ratio of 2.8:1 (requires 3:1). Impact: Users with color vision deficiencies may miss button boundaries. Fix: Add 1px border: `border: 1px solid #4CAF50;` (3.1:1 ratio). ## INTERACTIVE FEEDBACK ISSUE #6 [SEVERITY: High] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 2.4.7 Focus Visible] Description: No visible focus indicator on the "Join" button or PLAY dropdown. Impact: Keyboard users cannot identify focused elements. Fix: Add `outline: 2px solid #4CAF50; outline-offset: 2px;` to focus states. ISSUE #7 [SEVERITY: Medium] [FRAMEWORK: Nielsen] [CRITERION: Visibility of System Status] Description: Missing hover state for the PLAY dropdown arrow. Impact: Users cannot confirm interactivity. Fix: Add `transform: rotate(180deg);` transition to the dropdown arrow on hover. ## FORM DESIGN ISSUE #8 [SEVERITY: Low] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions] Description: The PLAY button contains "READY TO PLAY" text but lacks an associated label. Impact: Screen readers may not announce the button's purpose clearly. Fix: Add `aria-label="Play Minecraft"` to the PLAY button element. ## NAVIGATION ISSUE #9 [SEVERITY: Medium] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 2.4.3 Focus Order] Description: Tab order appears non-logical: sidebar icons → PLAY button → Join button → WHAT'S NEW section. Impact: Keyboard users experience inefficient navigation. Fix: Reorder focus sequence: sidebar → PLAY button → Join button → WHAT'S NEW. ## LOADING & EMPTY STATES ISSUE #10 [SEVERITY: Medium] [FRAMEWORK: Nielsen] [CRITERION: Visibility of System Status] Description: Only text-based loading indicators ("Loading skin...", "Loading content...") without visual feedback. Impact: Users may think the application is unresponsive. Fix: Add spinner icon next to loading text: `
Loading skin...` ## ERROR HANDLING ISSUE #11 [SEVERITY: Low] [FRAMEWORK: Nielsen] [CRITERION: Help Users Recognize, Diagnose, and Recover from Errors] Description: No error state handling visible for failed skin loading. Impact: Users don't know what to do when loading fails. Fix: Add retry button: `` below loading text. ## RESPONSIVENESS ISSUE #12 [SEVERITY: Critical] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 1.4.10 Reflow] Description: At 320px width, the layout requires horizontal scrolling (sidebar + main content). Impact: Mobile users cannot access content. Fix: Implement responsive sidebar collapse: `display: none;` on sidebar below 768px. ## ACCESSIBILITY ISSUE #13 [SEVERITY: High] [FRAMEWORK: WCAG] [CRITERION: 2.1.1 Keyboard] Description: The "Join" button may not be keyboard focusable if not properly tabbed. Impact: Keyboard-only users cannot interact with the button. Fix: Ensure button has `tabindex="0"` and is in proper tab order. ## CONSISTENCY ISSUE #14 [SEVERITY: Medium] [FRAMEWORK: Nielsen] [CRITERION: Consistency and Standards] Description: Button styles inconsistent: PLAY button is dark gray with white text, Join button is green with white text. Impact: Users must learn different interaction patterns. Fix: Standardize button design: use consistent padding (16px 24px) and typography. ## PERFORMANCE PERCEPTION ISSUE #15 [SEVERITY: Low] [FRAMEWORK: LawOfUX] [CRITERION: Doherty Threshold] Description: No loading progress indicator for skin download. Impact: Users perceive slower loading times. Fix: Add progress bar: `` ## MINIMALISM ISSUE #16 [SEVERITY: Low] [FRAMEWORK: LawOfUX] [CRITERION: Occam's Razor] Description: "AD" label on LunaSMP card is redundant with visual design. Impact: Visual clutter. Fix: Remove "AD" text; use visual design to indicate advertisement.
